message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and while my neighbors scrambled for candles, I was the gloriously over-prepared one, pulling out my trusty lantern and power banks like a scene from a survival show. It felt good to know that my phone was charged and I could still enjoy a snack from the cooler instead of rummaging through the dark. Who knew being ready could feel so cozy? Have you ever found yourself unexpectedly prepared for a situation?
